recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見大量小到中型、核質比極高、胞質極少且無顆粒的原始細胞，染色質較緻密，部分彼此擠壓成群；背景有許多淡粉紅、破碎的污跡細胞（smudge cells），在青少年極高白血球的情境下提示急性淋巴母細胞白血病，T 系需流式確認。
features: Numerous small to intermediate-sized blasts with very high N:C ratio
Round to irregular nuclei with relatively condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods
Cluster of larger blasts with nuclear moulding in the center of the field
Many pale pink disrupted smudge cells in the background
Normocytic red cells; platelets not appreciably seen
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous blasts, ranging from small to intermediate in size, with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, relatively condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. A cluster of slightly larger blasts with nuclear moulding is present, and there are abundant smudge cells, reflecting the fragility of the leukemic cells at a very high white cell count. No Auer rods, granules or dysplastic granulocytes are seen, and platelets appear decreased. The morphology is consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; with flow cytometry demonstrating CD2, CD3, CD5, CD7, CD8 and CD34 expression, findings support T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are morphologically indistinguishable and require flow cytometry showing CD19, CD22, CD79a rather than cyCD3.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of mature T-cell neoplasm (e.g., T-PLL)
ddx.vs: T-PLL cells have a visible single nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs and are TdT/CD34 negative mature T cells.
CLL shows mature small lymphocytes with block-like soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells in older adults, CD5/CD23/CD19 positive and TdT negative.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts are agranular too but express CD13/CD33/CD117 without cyCD3 and T-lineage antigens.
